lines.zh: 我是一个方块，慢慢滑过去。
lines.en: I am a block, sliding slowly along.

lines.zh: 我的表面颜色一点点变。
lines.en: The colors on my surface shift bit by bit.

lines.zh: 我一颠一颠地穿过草地。
lines.en: I bob across the grass.
I shift toward that door.
My edge drags across the soil.
I go around the stones.
I am slow, but I have not stopped.
I squeeze through the doorway.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方颜色会变。
lines.en: The colors change where I pass.
I rub forward inch by inch.
I turn toward the light.
I round the corner of the wall.
I rub forward a little more.
I stop at the door frame.
I slide slowly down the steps.
I slide off toward the open ground.
I hold still while the colors keep flowing.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，很不舒服地站着。
lines.en: I stand still, and it is unpleasant.

lines.zh: 我的表面有一层渐变色。
lines.en: My surface carries a gradient.
I face the sun.
I wait for the door to open.
I stand still while colors keep running.
I turn a slow half circle.

lines.zh: 颜色在我身上走了一圈。
lines.en: A band of color travels over me.
I hear sounds inside the house.
I tip once.
I square my edges.
I keep my place.

lines.zh: 我把有颜色的一面转给你。
lines.en: I turn my colored face to you.
You have stared far too long.
I tilt slowly.
I have no face, yet I watch you.
You reach and I retreat.
I move to one side.
I stop before you.
You carry very little color.
I set myself straight.
Staring like that is unpleasant.
A corner of me chips.
I lean to one side.
My colors scramble.
I right myself slowly.
I rock for quite a while.

lines.zh: 这一下记在我的色带里。
lines.en: That is noted in my color band.
I am still a block.
I shift off a little.
I am somewhat uncomfortable.
This block of me can still slide.
I take nothing into my mouth.
You raise it and I do not stir.
That thing is very pale.
I shift a little around it.
I have no use for these.
I shift off the other way.
I pause and move on.
Your hand is in my way.

lines.zh: 我用边角把它推到旁边。
lines.en: I nudge it aside with my corner.
I slide on my way regardless.
You knock me a little off line.
I slide slowly back into place.
A corner of me is chipped.
I rock once and settle.
I slide past the side of your leg.
I am hard; hitting me is unpleasant.
I shift forward again.
You have stepped on my edge.
I give way sideways.
Do not kick my edge.
I am a block.
I cannot manage that.
I tilt to show I do not understand.
I slide off to the other side.

lines.zh: 两个方块靠在一起也没意思。
lines.en: Two blocks together mean nothing.
I go on sliding.
I square my corners.
I present my back.
I uttered not one syllable.
The color still travels over me.
I cannot do anything with it.
I touch it with my corner.
It stuck to my surface.
I cannot shake it off.
It slid off.
I try once more.
I shove it off with my corner.
I let it stay where it is.
I tilt toward it.
I slide on along my way.
Something is shifting.
I turn my face that way.
I ring it in my sight.
I press slowly toward it.
It has not taken note of me.
I stop several steps off.
The color on my face shifts.
I move to its flank.
I am all set.
I keep closing in.
I move toward one side of it.
I have no limbs; I can only ram.
My front stays toward it.
It moves a step, I slide a step.
I press closer a bit at a time.
It turns its head and I brake.
I hold to its flank.
My color keeps shifting.
It seems not to have seen me.
I come nearer.
I take a new aspect.
I hold there without moving.
I slide slowly behind it.
When it comes close, I ram.
I slam my whole block into it.
I butt it with my corner.
That was very stiff.
It pushes and I tilt.
I ram a second time.
I am bounced back a stretch.
I shift slowly back into place.
I suppose I have struck.
I come to a stop.
I push myself up out of the earth.
I am a gradient block.
Colors travel slowly over me.
I look over all four sides.
The houses here have doors.
I shift toward the nearest door.
The gradient is still on me.
I shift one step and stop.
I have no particular purpose.
I slide slowly out.
Fire blackens my colors.
I land and a corner breaks.

lines.zh: 水进了我表面，颜色散了。
lines.en: Water seeps into my surface and the color runs.
The blast flips me over.

lines.zh: 有东西在我的面上打了洞。
lines.en: Something punches a hole in my face.
Strange force presses me down.
No more color flows in.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的颜色全白了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my colors all go white.

lines.zh: 我一路往下掉，颜色散了。
lines.en: I fall away and my colors scatter.
